subject: Request: Private VPC deployment — limited audit access & onboarding credit
messages:
From: Anil Reddy <anil.reddy@aperturelabs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC + audit access request / commercial ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Aperture Labs is ready to move to a private VPC deployment for our inference workloads but we have a few non-standard requirements that we need to confirm prior to legal sign-off:

- Data residency: All customer PII and model inputs must remain in us-east-1 (no cross-region replication).
- Audit / forensic window: We need the ability to request a 45-day forensic snapshot and runbook access for investigations (read-only access to ops runbooks for the relevant nodes).
- Key management: We require integration with our KMS (customer-managed keys) and a supported HSM-backed signing path for critical secrets.
- Access controls: Any vendor engineer access must be timeboxed and require 2FA + recorded session logs; Aperture will only request emergency RCE-level access with 24-hour notice.

Commercial ask: because migration and egress testing are sizeable, we are requesting a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration costs (we'd target ~$75k). We are also seeking an introductory discount for the first 12 months while we validate throughput (approx 30% off list).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support the technical constraints above and whether these commercial requests are within scope for an exec-approved concession?

Attached: initial SOW draft (SOW_Aperture_draft.docx) — still rough.

Thanks,
Anil Reddy
Head of Infrastructure, Aperture Labs
anil.reddy@aperturelabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Anil Reddy <anil.reddy@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC + audit access request / commercial ask

Hi Anil — appreciate the clear list. High-level answers:

- Residency: yes, we can pin the tenant to us-east-1 and disable cross-region replication.
- Audit window: we support timeboxed forensic exports; I need to confirm the entitlement window length with our ops and security teams (45 days is above our default, which is 30 days).
- KMS/HSM: supported via our KMS integration; we'll need to validate the specific provider and key lifecycle requirements.
- Engineer access: we can provide recorded, timeboxed sessions and require 2FA; any RCE-level access would be restricted and require change approvals.

On the commercial side, I’m looping in Marissa and Legal (Lauren) to start a concession request with Deal Desk. Marissa — can you pick this up?

Next steps: please send the finalized SOW and any compliance artifacts you can share (SOC2 report, scope) and we'll run a quick technical feasibility pass.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, priy a_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private VPC + audit access request / commercial ask — concession ask

Team — forwarding Aperture’s request and summarizing the commercial ask for Deal Desk review:

Summary: Aperture (mid-market healthtech) wants private VPC (us-east-1), 45-day forensic snapshots, KMS integration, timeboxed runbook access, and a one-time onboarding credit (~$75k) plus a 12-month introductory discount (~30%). ARR estimate: ~$1.1M first-year run rate if we land them at expected volume.

Recommendation (my read):
- Approve residency and KMS/HSM technical constraints — ops can support with a signed runbook access policy.
- Approve timeboxed read-only runbook access and recorded sessions. For forensic snapshots, recommend capping to 45 days for 12 months, then revert to 30 days unless we have an active support contract.
- Commercial concession: endorse a 25% discount on core inference usage for 12 months + a one-time onboarding credit of $60k (rather than $75k). This balances migration support and protects CAC.
- Require Legal (Lauren) to push a narrow audit-scope clause: Aperture can request forensic exports for specific tenant IDs only; no direct host-level credentials; all requests signed-off by a named security contact.

Asks for Exec: Karthik / Marcus — please sign off on the above concession (25% + $60k onboarding credit) or indicate a counter threshold. If approved, I’ll prepare a concession package for e-sign and update the SOW.

Attachments: Concession_Pkg.pdf (proposal for finance/discount math)

—Marissa
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — Aperture Labs (RDW-2028-4127)

Marcus — quick ask for your decision. We’ve validated tech feasibility; Legal drafted a narrow audit clause. Commercial recommendation: 25% off for 12 months + $60k one-time onboarding credit; SLA credit stays standard (5% annual uptime SLA credit) — no additional SLA concessions.

Economics: at 25% discount the first-year net ARR impact is ~ $275k (list move). Onboarding credit is prepaid credit against usage. If you prefer smaller downside, alternate offer is 18% + $30k onboarding credit.

If you approve, please reply all with approval text and any conditions (timebox, review cadence). If you reject, indicate which concession to fallback to and I’ll send to the customer.

Thanks,
Karthik (Deal Desk)
From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Anil Reddy <anil.reddy@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Aperture Labs (RDW-2028-4127)

Approve — with conditions.

Terms I approve: 25% discount on core inference usage for 12 months and a one-time onboarding credit of $60k applied as account credit. Conditions:
1) Forensic snapshot window limited to 45 days for the first 12 months only; after the 12-month period the entitlement reverts to our standard 30-day window unless a renewal concession is negotiated.
2) Runbook access must be read-only and limited to named engineers. All sessions must be recorded and logs retained for 12 months.
3) KMS integration is allowed but customer keys must not be exported; we require evidence of key-holder controls and rotation policy before go-live.
4) Legal to include a narrow audit clause: requests must be scoped to tenant IDs and signed by Aperture’s Head of Security; no live host shell access granted.
5) Finance to approve the credit accounting treatment; onboarding credit applied against usage over the first 6 months.

Lauren — please finalize the redline with Aperture and return the signed SOW & concession addendum. Priya/Marissa — prepare the technical runbook and support plan for the pre-prod migration.

Anil — happy to move forward on that basis. Please confirm you accept these conditions and share the finalized SOW.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
